tenderSchedule.title: Panchayath essential services
tenderSchedule.description: Annual Pump and Motor Maintainance Work for the year 2026-27
tenderSchedule.deptName: Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Department
tenderSchedule.locationName: RDPR Gram Panchayat Office Doddabanahalli TP Bengaluru East

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Tenderer should quote rate inclusive of GST
Bidders should abide to all the Terms and Conditions attached
The Tender Processing Fee shall not be refundable
Before Quoting the rates tenderer should read the bid document carefully
Local Suppliers are prefered for the purpose of service and Maintainance
Bidder must do work withing 10Km of PanchyathLimit,bidder must do workwith in 24hr after panchyath intimation and it should written in 100rs Bond paper and upload the same document in kppp port

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: To qualify for Award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years, i.e. 2019-20 to2023-24 satisfactorily completed as prime contractor, at least one similar work of value not less than 80 PERCENT OF THE WORK
